_description: Cascade Starter 9 — Second cohort for Starter tier validation. Fresh accounts in cybersecurity, legal tech, and logistics verticals. Same KPI set as starter_9_saas.json but entirely new narratives.

_kpi_map.P1-KPI1: DAU Rate — baseline for Signal Analyst, product adoption ROI
_kpi_map.P1-KPI3: TTFV — stalled_deployment arc detection, primary Power-of-1 metric
_kpi_map.P2-KPI1: Exec Sponsor Engagement — STAKEHOLDER nodes, exec_sponsor_change arcs
_kpi_map.P3-KPI1: Ticket Resolution Time — support efficiency, Cost Savings in ROI
_kpi_map.P3-KPI3: NPS — sentiment_decline arc, Wizard C calibration signal
_kpi_map.P3-KPI4: Escalation Rate — crisis_recovery arcs, high-fidelity SIGNAL
_kpi_map.P5-KPI1: NRR — L4 health rollup, EV/Revenue multiple impact
_kpi_map.P5-KPI2: GRR — Wizard C calibration, Churn Prevented dollar impact

accounts.name: Ironclad Legal Ops
accounts.narrative: Legal tech Series B. Contract workflow automation onboarded Oct 2025, hit TTFV in 11 days. DAU at 74%, NPS 54. Legal Ops Director championing expansion to paralegal and billing teams — two new BUs in pipeline.

key_signals.content: DAU hit 74% — contract review team fully onboarded in first 6 weeks
Director requesting platform access for paralegal team and billing — est. 40 new seats

accounts.name: FreightPath Logistics
accounts.narrative: Supply chain SaaS. Stable warehouse ops usage, strong exec engagement. NRR at 108%, GRR 91%. Exec sponsor (COO) proactively engaged — exploring integration with their TMS for Q3 expansion.

key_signals.content: COO requested cross-functional demo for TMS integration — expansion intent confirmed

accounts.name: Sentinel Cyber Defense
accounts.narrative: Cybersecurity SaaS. Deployed for SOC team, TTFV was 14 days. DAU stable at 62%. NPS 41 (acceptable). Ticket escalation rate edging up post-Q1 product update — monitoring but manageable.

key_signals.content: Escalation rate rose from 2% to 4.5% after Q1 product update — root cause under investigation

accounts.name: ProcureMax Manufacturing
accounts.narrative: Manufacturing ERP-adjacent SaaS. Procurement lead (champion) restructured out in Dec. Replacement is skeptical — still using legacy system. DAU dropped from 68% to 38%. Exec sponsor unresponsive since Jan.

key_signals.content: Director of Procurement Harold Weston left in org restructure — primary platform driver
DAU dropped from 68% to 38% — new procurement manager defaulting to legacy ERP
New manager piloting Coupa for procurement workflows

actions.action: Stakeholder re-mapping — identified Mia Nakamura as bridge contact
actions.outcome: Demo scheduled for new procurement team on Q2 workflow automation
SVP agreed to 45-day evaluation before switching decision

accounts.name: Vertex Professional Services
accounts.narrative: B2B professional services firm. Data migration to cloud caused ticket volume explosion — resolution time at 56hrs. Escalation rate 11%. NPS dropped from 43 to 17. GRR declining. Exec sponsor demanding SLA review.

key_signals.content: Cloud migration caused 3x increase in ticket volume — resolution time spiked to 56hrs
COO escalated to our CEO — formal SLA breach notification sent
NPS fell from 43 to 17 — majority of survey responses cite platform instability

actions.action: Dedicated support squad — 6hr SLA override implemented
actions.outcome: Resolution time improving to 34hrs — downward trend confirmed

actions.action: Engineering lead joined weekly COO review
actions.outcome: Migration root cause found — rollback plan approved by both parties

accounts.name: CivicCore Government Tech
accounts.narrative: GovTech SaaS. Budget cuts forced team reduction — exec sponsor laid off, platform usage collapsed. DAU at 18%, NPS 6, escalation rate 19%. GRR at 66%. New agency CTO hostile to vendor spend. Renewal in 60 days — emergency C-suite intervention underway.

key_signals.content: Deputy Director Hayes laid off in budget reduction — was primary exec sponsor
DAU collapsed from 61% to 18% — team reduction left only 2 active users
New CTO flagged all SaaS contracts for non-renewal review — cost consolidation mandate
CTO's team evaluating open-source alternative with state IT consortium

actions.action: CEO-to-Commissioner call — presented compliance ROI and audit trail value
actions.outcome: Commissioner agreed to 90-day review before cancellation

actions.action: Dedicated CSM assigned + re-onboarding of remaining team
actions.outcome: DAU recovering to 32% — 5 new users activated from adjacent department

actions.action: Audit savings report showing $3.4M in compliance cost avoided
actions.outcome: CTO opened bilateral renewal discussion — budget exception request filed
